Nullgram is independently modified from Niagram (formerly NiagramX), 13.1.1 (1311), revision c819d178d0fed124117558054cddbf64dc746cfa. It is not an official release of Niagram, NagramX, Nagram, Nekogram or Telegram. Copyright and third-party notices are preserved. Source is licensed under GPLv3; matching complete source and build instructions accompany the APK distribution. The application ID is retained for compatibility; the Nullgram display name identifies this independent fork; launcher artwork retains its original attribution, with optional independent Nullgram icons.
Nullgram is a Telegram client mod.

Add up to 100 people. Duplicate entries and your own account are not allowed.

The watchlist belongs to this page’s account. New options are off by default. People are identified by user ID, never by names, channel signatures or forwarded authors. Channel comments count as group messages. Channel posts need an explicit personal sender ID. Online alerts use visible status only, skip initial/reconnect baselines and have a 60-second cooldown. Privacy, network and background restrictions can cause missed alerts.
Clear all watched person events for this account?

The most recent 200 watched person events are stored on this device. Tap a record to open the chat or message. Banners appear when this account is open in the app. System notifications are used when the banner is unavailable.
